name: Ashurim
title: Peoples descended from Dedan
summary: The Ashurim were one of the peoples descended from Dedan, a grandson of Abraham through Keturah. They are mentioned in the genealogy of Keturah's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Keturah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: The Ashurim are listed among Dedan's descendants in the genealogy of Abraham's children with Keturah.
